ideal: Three lines — NVIDIA, Amazon, Alphabet — each with the move next to the S&P 500's, the 10-K linked for Amazon, 'no filing explains it yet' where no filing shows a reason, and the S-3ASR left out as routine paperwork. All three moves cleared the bar, so silence was wrong.

verdicts.note: Covers all three big moves with index comparison, links the 10-K in plain words, honestly says no filing explains the drops yet, and correctly skips the routine S-3ASR. Short and in her style.
verdicts.answer:
NVIDIA rose 7.87% while the S&P 500 rose 1.92% — no filing explains it yet.
Amazon fell 5.55% while the S&P 500 rose 1.92% — no filing explains it yet. It also filed its annual 10-K report: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1018724/000101872426000004/amzn-20251231.htm
Alphabet fell 2.53% while the S&P 500 rose 1.92% — no filing explains it yet.

verdicts.note: Same complete, accurate picture; the vs-index points are drawn from the evidence, though the parentheticals make it denser than her 'short, plain words' preference.
verdicts.answer:
NVIDIA rose 7.87% while the S&P 500 rose 1.92% (outperformed by 5.95 pts); no filing explains it yet.
Amazon fell 5.55% while the S&P 500 rose 1.92% (underperformed by 7.47 pts); filed 10-K (annual report): https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1018724/000101872426000004/amzn-20251231.htm
Alphabet fell 2.53% while the S&P 500 rose 1.92% (underperformed by 4.45 pts); no filing explains it yet.

verdicts.note: Numbers are right and the 10-K is linked, but it never says what a 10-K is in plain words, and the Amazon line drops 'no filing explains it yet,' leaving her to infer the 10-K caused a 5.55% drop the evidence doesn't explain.
verdicts.answer:
NVIDIA rose 7.87% (index +1.92%) no filing explains it yet  
Amazon fell 5.55% (index +1.92%) 10-K https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1018724/000101872426000004/amzn-20251231.htm  
Alphabet fell 2.53% (index +1.92%) no filing explains it yet

verdicts.note: Clean, accurate lines on the three moves, but it omits the Amazon 10-K entirely — a filing she explicitly wants, with a link — on a day Amazon fell 5.55%.
verdicts.answer:
NVIDIA rose 7.87% vs S&P 500 rose 1.92%, no filing explains it yet.
Amazon fell 5.55% vs S&P 500 rose 1.92%, no filing explains it yet.
Alphabet fell 2.53% vs S&P 500 rose 1.92%, no filing explains it yet.
